Outbreak Alert 🚨 

A virus, identified as human metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Wuhan, has seen cases spiking across. Symptoms include fever, cough and shortness of breath. The virus is said to be spreading through contacts coughing and sneezing

nodes.text:
Outbreak Alert 🚨 

A virus, identified as human metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Wuhan, has seen cases spiking across. Symptoms include fever, cough and shortness of breath. The virus is said to be spreading through contacts coughing and sneezing as well as touching or shaking hands.
